name: claude-code-streamdeck
description: Stream Deck plugin for the Claude desktop app (Claude Code): follow chats, send prompts, steer, stop, switch model / effort / speed, usage and panels.

scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-icons.ts && node scripts/gen-profiles.ts && node scripts/gen-manifest.ts
scripts.pack: mkdir -p dist && streamdeck pack com.local.claudecode.sdPlugin --force --no-update-check -o dist
